integrity: Mathematical formulas and exact verification code are provided; independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Complete multipartite graphs with at least three nonempty parts and palette of exactly one more colour than the chromatic number; other graphs and larger surpluses are not covered. Finite direct enumeration confirms small cases, while the unbounded claim rests on an explicit structural proof. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Forced colouring with one surplus colour on complete multipartite graphs
